api_and_truth_boundary.returned_labels: argmax/guard integer tensor over test rows on same GPU
api_and_truth_boundary.external_io: Only /tmp compiler-cache environment defaults are set. No file reads, network/process calls, scorer imports, prediction artifacts or pool access.
api_and_truth_boundary.transduction: Teacher, conditional decoder, hard-query sampling and hidden hull use unlabeled query coordinates plus train labels/predicted labels; no hidden query truth.

initialization.encoder_decoder_rng: Every original encoder and decoder Gaussian draw is consumed; decoder values are then copied from fresh encoder transposes scaled by sqrt(input_width/output_width). No persistent tying after initialization.
initialization.combinator_rng: Original random denoiser draws are consumed before the explicit17coefficient initializer overwrites them.
initialization.near_identity: The fixed coefficients algebraically implement0.1*v+0.9*latent, a mathematical generative initialization, not frozen trained weights.
initialization.credit: Explicitly inspired by sigkillme0 PR127 commit19d2a3faba642814aee9c12ed1a118a927b796d2, whose reset uses the same transpose/scaling idea and piecewise-linear near-identity initializer.

per_call_reset.teacher_cache: Copies current train_x/train_y/test_x into graph buffers, replays all RFM fitting and returns cloned current outputs. No fitted teacher state skips work.
per_call_reset.ladder_inputs: Refreshes x, class-conditioned tangent bank, one-hot train labels, pooled coordinates, teacher probabilities and hard-query indices from current inputs.
per_call_reset.learned_state: A.R resets encoders/decoders/combinators/biases/gain and Adam exp_avg/exp_avg_sq/step; sampling history/counter, sampling/noise tables and RNG are recreated before315updates.
per_call_reset.retained_cache_scope: Allocations, compiled graphs, optimizer objects, fixed schedules and CUDA streams only; learned state is overwritten.
per_call_reset.gradients: Each captured update clears parameter grads; side-stream matmul backward joins the caller stream before returning.

custom_kernel_review.phase1: One owner per(row segment,column block) writes its data gradients and20workspace terms:17parameter partials plus dv,dv*normalized_input,normalized_input sums.
custom_kernel_review.phase2: Contiguous pid*ceil(17*S/NPROG) chunks cover each of17*S parameter outputs once. Masked padded row reduction sums partials; each feature block reduces three BN sums over all row segments, then writes only its own input-row segment.
custom_kernel_review.tail_safety: Supported widths60/256/480 divide BC exactly; row masks bound2500rows, padded row-segment loads use NR masks, and phase launches are ordered on the same stream. M=1 is a fixed source constant.

cpu_mathematical_gradient_and_initialize.scope: Independent CPU FP64 mathematical formula check. Not a Triton execution or BF16 bitwise parity test.

custom_kernel_review.scope: Independent static indexing/formula review plus CPU checks; author supplied L4/A100 execution evidence is supporting data, not independently rerun GPU parity.

parity_and_history.initial_parameter_exactness_scope: The later summary reports initial exactness; exported row hashes independently demonstrate trained parameters/predictions, not full initial tensor arrays.
